description: Rail Infrastructure Manager Data is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by BITRE. As part of Trainline 9 a new rail tonnage time series visualisation was created. The underlying data can be downloaded on this page. The data shows total and inter-capital intermodal tonnes on parts of the Australian interstate rail network. The tonnes are shown across a number of segments by direction of travel. Coverage is Australia, 2007 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-21. Files and pages listed: XLSX (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
